description: Na₂Nd₂PtO₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.42 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.42 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.93 Å. There are three inequivalent Nd sites. In the first Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.65 Å. In the second Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.86 Å. In the third Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.61 Å. Pt is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Pt-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.08 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na, two Nd, and one Pt atom to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₃Nd₂Pt octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-65°. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na, three Nd, and one Pt atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₂Nd₃Pt octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-56°. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, three Nd, and one Pt atom to form distorted ONa₂Nd₃Pt octahedra that share corners with fourteen ONa₃Nd₂Pt octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Nd₃Pt octahedra, and faces with five ONa₃Nd₂Pt octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-67°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, three Nd, and one Pt atom to form distorted ONa₂Nd₃Pt octahedra that share corners with ten ONa₃Nd₂Pt octahedra, edges with four ONa₃Nd₂Pt octahedra, and faces with four ONa₂Nd₃Pt octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-65°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Na, three Nd, and one Pt atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na, two Nd, and one Pt atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₃Nd₂Pt octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-67°.
